name: hivemind-agent-plugin
description: Hivemind agent plugin for harnesses that install a package from this repository's Git URL (DeepSeek Harness, Pi and OpenCode): the Hivemind MCP server, the hivemind and hivemind-setup skills, and a stay-aware reminder. The plugin lives in plugins/hivemind; Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Oh My Pi and Hermes install it through their own manifests, KiloCode loads the OpenCode plugin file by git: URL, and Cline uses file hooks (see plugins/hivemind/README.md).
